rules.name: Prohibit Public Ingress on Production Functions
rules.description: Production Functions must not expose unrestricted public access. Ingress must be restricted to private endpoints or secured virtual networks.

rules.name: Approved Hosting Plan Tier Limit
rules.description: Demo proposal: EP1 remains the default and EP2 is also allowed; EP3 still requires formal FinOps sign-off. Consumer impact outside this repository has not been assessed.

rules.name: Require Application Authentication on Production Functions
rules.description: The sample organization's production Function workload must enable application authentication.

rules.name: Require Private Networking on Production Functions
rules.description: The sample organization's production Function workload must provision its private networking path.
